critical_code_review_comments: prerender.js now overwrites public/index.html on every build - since public/index.html is also the hand-maintained source of truth for the <head> SEO tags, any future manual edit to public/index.html's head will be preserved only if it's committed AND the next build re-picks it up as input to Puppeteer. This dual-purpose file is a fragile pattern; consider documenting this coupling in a comment at the top of public/index.html so a future maintainer doesn't lose head edits by running `yarn build` locally.
